parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top movable part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic. It is small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid from the bottle through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via an internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head section connects the pressing lid to the base body and includes the nozzle for liquid output. It is made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the nozzle when the lid is pressed, ensuring controlled dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but contains internal moving components that facilitate fluid flow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of polyethylene plastic. It is cylindrical and holds the liquid content.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (such as soap, lotion, or sanitizer) and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and serves as the stable foundation of the dispenser.
